exposure: Volatile organic compound (VOC) biomarkers in fecal samples
outcome: Neonatal sepsis status (positive or negative, confirmed by blood culture)
cohort: The study included 32 fecal samples from neonates, comprising 17 positive and 15 negative sepsis cases confirmed by blood culture.
finding: The MLPNN machine learning model achieved high performance (90.63% accuracy, 88.24% sensitivity, 93.33% specificity) in distinguishing neonates with positive and negative sepsis using fecal VOC biomarkers detected by the cNose system.
cross-section timing: At the point of suspected or confirmed sepsis, for real-time and bedside detection.
